The primitive 'Inflight Implies Held' closes this gap by enforcing that any in-flight attempt must have originated from a held credit state. This ensures that dispatches are only valid when credit is properly secured. The second primitive, 'Dispatch Under Exposure Hold', explicitly models this constraint as a necessary condition for dispatch. The third primitive, 'Credit Contention Resolution', captures how contention within the credit system affects admission decisions, ensuring that resource limits are respected even in composed environments.
